C7 ordinary BFS distance = 36; witness word baaaaaabaaaaaabaaaaaabaaaaaabaaaaaab has length 36 and simulates Q->{0}. All 14 one-hole mutants return careful-BFS None (no singleton reachable under careful semantics where a letter is allowed only if defined on the whole current set). Trap identities re-simulated: b(Q)={0..5}=F, b(F)=F, a(F)={1..6}=G, b(G)=F, a(Q)=Q. Hand trap proof for Theorem 2 checked case-by-case: Case A (a-hole s<6) correctly traps in {Q,F}; Case C/D (b-holes) correctly observe Q cannot be left carefully (Q-b forbidden, Q-a=Q loop); Case B (a-hole at 6) correctly traps in {Q,F,G} with F<->G oscillation. Minor imprecision: Draft Case B says 'plus Q-a->Q loops' but a is undefined at 6 in Q so Q-a is forbidden, not a loop; reachable set remains subset of {Q,F,G} and conclusion unaffected. All 98 fill-landscape cells independently recomputed via ordinary BFS and match committed CSV and DRAFT table exactly; original-entry diagonal all 36 as required. Canonical completions all equal C7 with length 36. Draft honestly separates proved (Thm 1-2) from computed-not-hand-proved (98 fill cells). No boundary error: scope is exactly 2*7=14 mutants under stated labelling.

originality.rationale: Compared substantively against nearest priors, not by timestamp. Vorel 1403.3972 gives strongly exponential asymptotic careful/subset lower bounds and PSPACE-completeness even for strongly connected binary automata - no exact small-n per-mutant values or gap table. Cambie et al. 2108.13927 proves maximal binary-PFA threshold >(n-1)^2 iff n>=6 with Fibonacci/Padovan formulas for parametric family C_n^c and maximality to n=10 - family contains at most one deletion pattern per (n,c), reports careful thresholds only, not per-mutant careful-vs-completion gaps over full 14-mutant C7 ball. de Bondt et al. 1801.10436 reports PFA maxima for n<=7, occurring binary-PFA lengths to n<=10, quadratic series and exponential (including single-undefined transitive) constructions - maxima/series, not C7 one-hole gap map; uses different (non-careful-vs-completion) tabulation. Martyugin CIAA 2012 proves PSPACE-completeness of checking careful synchronizability with one undefined transition (binary included) - complexity dichotomy only, no lengths/witnesses. Szykula survey frames careful/subset thresholds as live frontier but contains no such table. Internal Resultary hits SCOPE007/SCOPE006 concern complete-DFAs ordinary reset lengths, not partial-automata careful semantics. No checked source tabulates per-mutant careful verdicts plus completion gaps over C7 one-hole ball, and uniform-NO verdict plus 98-cell ordinary-fill landscape is not mechanically implied by maxima/asymptotics/complexity results.

value.rationale: Headline fallback claim judged separately from failed strict-separation target. Object is pre-motivated and natural: C7 is the canonical smallest extremal where binary-PFA thresholds can exceed (n-1)^2 (Cambie iff n>=6); full single-deletion ball (14 mutants) is the extremal-anchored canonical neighbourhood, not an arbitrary slice. Invariant is pre-motivated: cost of carefulness vs ordinary completion in the Martyugin/Vorel careful-synchronization program, framed as live frontier by Szykula survey, with stated downstream uses (careful-heuristic calibration, supervisory-control/coding-sync models with forbidden transitions). Value was unknown and not mechanically implied: uniform fragility (0/14 carefully synchronizing) with exact trap explanation F<->G oscillation is a stability fact guiding future search away from the one-hole ball toward multi-hole/other-n scopes. Short proof does not equal textbook restatement. Bonus 98-cell completion-fill ordinary-length landscape (values 6..36 plus certified NS cells with diagonal 36) provides varied exact benchmark data beyond the uniform gap table. Draft describes incompleteness honestly (no claims beyond n=7, stated labelling, multi-hole out of scope) and does not call vacuous gap table a separation. This is a rigorously established exact invariant set of a motivated natural object, retrievable as an extremal-anchored stability chart, not a mere parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained number.
